definitions.explanation: A legal or financial obligation to pay money or perform a duty. A formal term used in legal, financial, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{多額|たがく}の{債務|さいむ}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: The company is burdened with a large amount of debt.

examples.japanese: {債務|さいむ}を{返済|へんさい}するのに{10年|じゅうねん}かかった。
examples.english: It took 10 years to repay the debt.

examples.japanese: {債務|さいむ}{超過|ちょうか}で{倒産|とうさん}した。
examples.english: They went bankrupt due to excessive debt.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{債|さい} (debt, bond) + {務|む} (duty, obligation)

CONTRAST:
・{債務|さいむ} (debt - obligation to pay) ↔ {債権|さいけん} (credit - right to collect)
・{債務者|さいむしゃ} (debtor) ↔ {債権者|さいけんしゃ} (creditor)

FORMALITY:
・{債務|さいむ} - formal/legal term
・{借金|しゃっきん} - casual term for personal debt
・ローン - loanword for loans

COMMON COMPOUND TERMS:
・{債務|さいむ}{超過|ちょうか} (insolvency - liabilities exceed assets)
・{債務|さいむ}{整理|せいり} (debt consolidation/restructuring)
・{債務|さいむ}{不履行|ふりこう} (default on debt)
・{連帯|れんたい}{債務|さいむ} (joint and several liability)
・{多重|たじゅう}{債務|さいむ} (multiple debts - often problematic)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
{債務|さいむ} is the standard legal term in Japanese civil law for obligations that can be enforced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{債務|さいむ}を{負|お}う (to incur debt)
・{債務|さいむ}を{返済|へんさい}する (to repay debt)
・{債務|さいむ}が{膨|ふく}らむ (debt swells/grows)
・{債務|さいむ}から{逃|に}げる (to run from debt)
